# opnsense_haproxy_backend (Resource)

A HAProxy backend pool: a group of servers that receives the traffic a rule or frontend sends to it. Requires the `os-haproxy` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_backend" "web" {
  name           = "web"
  linked_servers = [opnsense_haproxy_server.web.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this backend pool. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` only.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Balancing algorithm: `source`, `roundrobin`, `static-rr`, `leastconn`, `uri` or `random`. Defaults to `source`.
- `description` (String) Description for this backend pool. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this backend pool. Defaults to `true`.
- `health_check_enabled` (Boolean) When enabled, HAProxy health-checks the servers in this pool. Defaults to `true`.
- `linked_servers` (Set of String) UUIDs of the servers in this pool. Defaults to `[]`.
- `mode` (String) Mode of the backend pool, `http` (layer 7) or `tcp` (layer 4). Defaults to `http`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the backend pool.
